created_from: Owner-reported editorial usefulness concern supported by sealed bundle metadata; no independent claim of watching both full programs.

incidents.impact: Both videos were selected from the same original company and are first-party Workday product-configuration lessons rather than source-diverse independent AI instruction.
incidents.issue: The same-publisher exception and medium-promotion risk classification allowed two product-specific 13.7/16.8-minute lessons. Signed-out playback and source-transcript review did not ensure independently useful, unbiased educational variety.
incidents.resolution: OPEN: published video links are unchanged. Genuine independently educational alternatives require exact-source content review and signed-out advancing playback, then a separate protected media-only correction.
incidents.playback_evidence_limit: Player advancement does not establish marketing neutrality, independent editorial value or absence of advertising.
incidents.prevention: Prospective October 30+ two-original-publisher rule and no two-medium-risk-video pair, plus source review in the existing Compiler task.
